_comment: Every secret the foundation's services use. Names and handling only, never values. `generate` says how scripts/secrets.py makes a new value: hex32 and b64key are random, es256 is a signing key from authctl gen-key (one line, in double quotes, newlines as \n), `provided` means an outside party issues it and someone pastes it in. `envs` limits a secret to some of the template environments: local, dev, prod (any other goes by its SHAPE). `env` says which services get it, under which variable, with ${NAME} and ${NAME:-default} filled in from secrets and settings: scripts/render.py writes each service's as secrets/<service>.env. An entry with no `generate` is a use: it adds services to a secret declared elsewhere, or gives a placeholder for one that may not exist. `rotation` says what `make rotate APPLY=1` does: replace (a new value, then deploy), account:<name> (authctl service-rotate, deploy, service-finish), signing-key (NEXT, deploy, then promote); without one, `make rotate` only prints `rotate`. Modules list theirs in <module>/secrets.json. upstream U8: the foundation could publish this per repo.

secrets.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
secrets.rotate: ALTER ROLE t10 PASSWORD …, change the value, then roll the services that connect as t10.

secrets.name: AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.rotate: Used once at bootstrap. Change the admin's password in the app afterwards.

secrets.name: AUTH_TOTP_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not rotatable without re-enrolling every TOTP. Generate once.

secrets.name: AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_CURRENT
secrets.rotate: Two-phase: make rotate NAME=AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_CURRENT ENV=<env> puts a new key in AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_NEXT; deploy, wait one token lifetime, then promote it to CURRENT and clear NEXT. Made on local too: without it, auth-server's dev mode makes a new key at every start, which signs out every session and voids each service's cached token until it expires.

secrets.name: AUTH_SIGNING_KEY_NEXT
secrets.rotate: Set only during a signing key rotation.

secrets.name: AGENT_TI_SECRET
secrets.rotate: authctl service-rotate --name=agent-ti, roll agent-ti, then authctl service-finish.

secrets.name: WORKBENCH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.rotate: Change, re-render clients.yaml, roll auth-server and workbench together. Sign-in fails briefly.

secrets.name: WORKBENCH_SESSION_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change and roll workbench. Everyone signs in again.

secrets.name: MODEL_KEY
secrets.rotate: Not rotatable yet: stored tenant model keys become unreadable. Back it up with the agent_control database.

secrets.name: GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change on both sides together, then roll.

secrets.name: AUDIT_CONSOLE_KEY
secrets.rotate: Change on all sides, then roll.

secrets.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Add a new key at the provider, roll ai-gateway-llm, revoke the old one.

secrets.name: SPEECH_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: As LLM_API_KEY. Empty means LLM_API_KEY is used, as when the model provider is DashScope too.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
secrets._comment: upstream U15: auth-server needs a value even without the livekit component, whose own entry replaces this placeholder.
